result.description: Cover normalized run storage, diagnostic persistence, cancellation, and the prohibition on logging credentials or raw source content.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Sqlite_HandoffMigration_DowngradeAndReupgrade, PostgreSql_HandoffMigration_DowngradeAndReupgrade and SqlServer_HandoffMigration_DowngradeAndReupgrade: on a clean database migrated only up to AddHandoffIngestionStorage, a downgrade to the immediately preceding migration removes AddHandoffIngestionStorage from the applied migrations and a re-upgrade restores it; proven first by HandoffCycleAssertion_AcceptsReversibleCycleAndRejectsMissingOrForwardOnlyCrossing over applied-migration lists (negative controls: the handoff migration still applied after the downgrade, absent after the re-upgrade, and a downgrade target older than 20260929140000_VersionedAuditPayloads) (PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 B12, triage-report-61c2a2b2).
The same tests then migrate the database to head, where a handoff ingestion run and its diagnostic persist and read back (PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 B12).

VersionedAuditPayloads_DownIsForwardOnly_OnEveryProvider: 20260929140000_VersionedAuditPayloads' Down raises NotSupportedException on SQLite, PostgreSQL and SQL Server, the forward-only boundary that migration declares, so no downgrade test crosses it (PLAN-SESSIONTRIAGEFIX-001 B12).
